issues.on_page: Local 191,735 (p6: Private Foundation Fund Local 175,000; p2 shows 175,000 as Public assistance Operating Grants and Contributions)
issues.issue: About 91% of this nonmajor 'Local' line is Private Foundation Fund money, which p2 classes as grants and contributions. Under the dominant-category rule, donations/contributions (with review) fits better than other. It is kept as other only through the generic 'Local' label category decision.

Broad 'Local' group. From p2 it works out to charges for services 144,528 (443,036 less Public works 298,508, which sits in Intergovernmental) + interest income 73,961 + miscellaneous 324,269 + private foundation contribution 175,000 = 717,758 exactly. No part is over half, so other with review is defensible. It is about 7.6% of governmental receipts.
The General Fund budget 'Local' line includes sale of surplus 7,470 (p5: 521,692 + 7,470). It is a broad mixed group with no dominant component printed, so other with review is defensible.
Matches p8, but p4/p5 print General Fund Taxes as 5,077,938, and p8 total disbursements are 4,264,243 against 4,264,244 on p5. These are $1 rounding differences in the report itself.
Road Fund intergovernmental is most likely mainly highway allocation. It is not itemized, so the detail category is a guess.
